title: Aetherica RIGOR-X Slash Command Library
compatibility_notice: This library contains platform-native commands, UI/menu tokens, community prompt macros, aliases, and image-generation keywords. A slash-prefixed entry is not necessarily executable by RIGOR-X or any particular host.
source_policy: Preserve source provenance and distinguish discovery from command-level verification. No entry is runtime-enabled by inclusion in this library.
